scope: Theorem 2.1 (Exterior Faber coefficients and the positive kernel) of the manuscript “A direct proof of the complete Crouzeix inequality” (preprints/A-direct-proof-of-the-complete-Crouzeix-inequality-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 325 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d9aa4ef2dccb1f04), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 3-4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let Ω be a bounded convex domain with regular real-analytic Jordan boundary. Let h be meromorphic and one-to-one on |λ| > r including infinity, where 0 < r < 1, with a simple pole at infinity as in (2.1), and mapping |λ| > 1 onto C \ Ω. Put q(λ) = λh′(λ) and define bk(z) by expansion at infinity: q(λ) h(λ) − z = X k≥0 bk(z)λ−k . (2.3) 3 Then b0 = 1, and each bk is a polynomial of degree k with leading coefficient c−k. There are scalars skj, k, j ≥ 1, such that bk(h(µ)) = µk + X j≥1 skjµ−j (k ≥ 1). (2.4) The function s(λ, µ) = q(λ) h(λ) − h(µ) − λ λ − µ = X k,j≥1 skjλ−k µ−j (2.5) extends holomorphically across the diagonal and both infinities in |λ|, |µ| > r. For every r < ρ < 1 there is a constant Cρ with |skj| ≤ Cρρk+j. The series converges normally on the exterior product collar: it converges absolutely and uniformly on every compact subset, including subsets meeting either infinity. In particular it converges absolutely and uniformly on T2. The continuous kernel K(λ, µ) = 1 + s(λ, µ) + s(λ, µ) is nonnegative and has integral one in each variable with the other fixed.
